name: default
description: The curated default pack: conservative, widely taught desk stretches covering neck, shoulders, upper/lower back, wrists, hands, hips, eyes and full body.
author: StretchBreak contributors

stretches.name: Blink reset
stretches.cue: Close your eyes, then blink slowly 5 times.
steps: Close eyes fully for 2 seconds.
Blink slowly and completely 5 times.
Notice if the screen looks sharper.

stretches.name: Shoulder drop
stretches.cue: Shrug up to your ears, hold 3s, let them fall.
steps: Lift both shoulders toward your ears.
Hold 3 seconds.
Exhale and let them drop completely. Repeat once.

stretches.name: Finger spread
stretches.cue: Spread fingers wide 5s, soft fist 5s.
steps: Lift hands off the keyboard.
Spread fingers as wide as they go, hold 5 seconds.
Curl into a loose fist, hold 5 seconds.

stretches.name: Jaw release
stretches.cue: Unclench jaw, tongue off the roof of your mouth, breathe out.
steps: Let your teeth part slightly.
Rest tongue behind lower teeth.
Take one slow breath out.

stretches.name: Far focus (20-20-20)
stretches.cue: Look at something 20 ft away for 20s.
steps: Pick the farthest object you can see (window, end of the room).
Rest your gaze there for 20 seconds.
Blink normally.

stretches.name: Chin tuck
stretches.cue: Glide chin straight back (double chin), hold 5s × 3.
steps: Sit tall, eyes level.
Slide your head straight back without tilting, making a double chin.
Hold 5 seconds, release. Repeat 3 times.

stretches.name: Neck side bend
stretches.cue: Ear toward shoulder, opposite shoulder down. 15s each side.
steps: Drop right ear toward right shoulder.
Keep left shoulder pressed down. Hold 15 seconds.
Switch sides.

stretches.name: Prayer stretch
stretches.cue: Palms together at chest, lower hands toward waist. Hold 20s.
steps: Press palms together in front of your chest, fingers up.
Keep palms touching and lower hands toward your waist until you feel the forearms.
Hold 20 seconds.

stretches.name: Wrist extensor stretch
stretches.cue: Arm out, palm down, gently pull fingers toward you. 15s each.
steps: Extend right arm, palm facing down.
With the left hand, gently pull the fingers back toward your body.
Hold 15 seconds. Switch.

stretches.name: Shoulder blade squeeze
stretches.cue: Pull shoulder blades together 5s, release. × 5.
steps: Sit tall, arms relaxed.
Draw shoulder blades together and slightly down, as if holding a pencil between them.
Hold 5 seconds, release fully. Repeat 5 times.

stretches.name: Seated spinal twist
stretches.cue: Hand on opposite knee, twist and look behind. 15s each side.
steps: Sit tall, feet flat.
Place right hand on left knee and left hand on the chair back.
Rotate torso left, look over the shoulder. Hold 15 seconds. Switch.

stretches.name: Seated thoracic extension
stretches.cue: Hands behind head, arch upper back over the chair, look up. 15s × 2.
steps: Interlace fingers behind your head.
Lean back over the top of the chair back, opening the chest and looking slightly upward.
Hold 15 seconds, sit up. Repeat once.

stretches.name: Seated cat-cow
stretches.cue: Hands on knees. Arch and look up, then round and look down. Slow, 45s.
steps: Hands on knees, feet flat.
Inhale: arch the back, lift the chest, look up.
Exhale: round the spine, tuck the chin.
Keep alternating slowly for 45 seconds.

stretches.name: Chest opener
stretches.cue: Clasp hands behind you, lift and open the chest. 20s × 2.
steps: Interlace fingers behind your lower back (or hold a wrist).
Straighten arms, gently lift hands away from you and lift the chest.
Hold 20 seconds, release. Repeat once.

stretches.name: Overhead side reach
stretches.cue: Reach one arm overhead and lean the other way. 20s each side.
steps: Reach right arm straight up.
Lean to the left, keeping both hips down. Feel the right side of the torso.
Hold 20 seconds. Switch sides.

stretches.name: Seated figure-four
stretches.cue: Ankle on opposite knee, hinge forward with a flat back. 25s each side.
steps: Place right ankle on left knee.
Keep back straight and hinge forward from the hips until you feel the outer hip.
Hold 25 seconds. Switch.

stretches.name: Standing hip flexor stretch
stretches.cue: Stand, step one foot back, tuck the pelvis, sink forward. 25s each side.
steps: Stand and step the right foot back into a half lunge.
Tuck the tailbone under and shift weight gently forward. Feel the front of the right hip.
Hold 25 seconds. Switch sides.

stretches.name: Doorway pec stretch
stretches.cue: Forearms on a doorframe, elbows at shoulder height, step through. 30s × 2.
steps: Stand in a doorway, forearms on each side of the frame, elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot through until you feel the chest open.
Hold 30 seconds, rest, repeat.

stretches.name: Calf raises + short walk
stretches.cue: Stand. 15 slow calf raises, then walk to the farthest wall and back.
steps: Stand behind your chair, hand on it for balance.
Rise onto your toes and lower slowly, 15 times.
Walk to the farthest point in the room and back, looking far ahead.

stretches.name: Standing forward fold
stretches.cue: Stand, soften knees, hang forward and let the head go. 30s, roll up slowly.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, knees slightly bent.
Hinge forward and let the arms and head hang heavy.
Breathe for 30 seconds, then roll up one vertebra at a time.
